**AFDK's Videncenter** (also referred to in the source documents as **RKKP's Videncenter** and **SundK's Videncenter**) is the analytical unit responsible for producing the core analyses in the Danish national annual reports on atrial fibrillation (AFDK). It operates as a central operational actor under the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP, also referred to as SundK) [^src1] [^src2]. 

The center is specifically credited with preparing the analytical sections of the [[afdk-aarsrapport-2023|Årsrapport 2023]] (published in 2024) and the subsequent 2025 report [^src1] [^src2]. In the 2024 publication, it is identified as RKKP's Videncenter [^src1], while in the 2025 publication, it is referred to as SundK's Videncenter [^src2]. Beyond its attribution in the introductory sections of these reports, no further operational details, personnel, or specific claims are documented in the provided corpus.
